tools.name: mxtoolbox_dns_lookup
tools.description: Run a simple DNS lookup for a domain: MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, A, AAAA, TXT, SOA, PTR, ASN or DNS. Returns passed, warning, failed and timeout checks. Uses the daily simple-lookup quota (64 a day on Free). Quotas reset daily at 00:00 UTC. MxToolbox API: GET /Lookup/{command}.

tools.name: mxtoolbox_network_lookup
tools.description: Run a network lookup: blacklist (email blocklists for an IP or domain), SMTP, HTTP/HTTPS, ping, TCP port check, or trace route. Uses the daily network quota, which is 0 on the Free plan (needs Basic or higher). The tcp command needs a port. MxToolbox API: GET /Lookup/{command}.

tools.name: mxtoolbox_list_monitors
tools.description: List the monitors on the account with their status, failing checks, warnings and tags. Filter by lookup command, monitored name, or tag. Needs a paid plan (Basic or higher). MxToolbox API: GET /Monitor.

tools.name: mxtoolbox_get_usage
tools.description: Show today's API usage: simple (DNS) and network lookups used, and the plan maximums for each. Works on every plan. MxToolbox API: GET /Usage.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mxtoolbox_network_lookup · Public sink: mxtoolbox_network_lookup · Destructive: mxtoolbox_dns_lookup, mxtoolbox_network_lookup.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: mxtoolbox_network_lookup · Public sink: mxtoolbox_network_lookup · Destructive: mxtoolbox_dns_lookup, mxtoolbox_network_lookup

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
